prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「地标」？
explanation: landmark 的意思是地标。

prompt: 「statue」的中文意思是哪一个？
explanation: statue 的意思是雕像。

prompt: 选择表示「寺庙」的单词。
explanation: 表示寺庙的单词是 temple。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「塔」？
explanation: tower 的意思是塔。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「景点」？
explanation: attraction 的意思是景点。

prompt: 「scenery」的中文意思是哪一个？
explanation: scenery 的意思是景色。

prompt: 选择表示「导游」的单词。
explanation: 表示导游的单词是 guide。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「排队」？
explanation: queue 的意思是排队。

prompt: 无论谁来当导游，我们都九点出发。哪一句正确？

choices.text: No matter who is the guide, we leave at nine
Whoever the guide is the queue
No matter who the guide is, we leave at nine
No matter whom the guide is he, we leave

explanation: who 在从句里作表语，语序是 the guide is，不是疑问语序。
verify: "No matter who the guide is, we leave at nine"

prompt: ___ you visit, take a photo of the statue. 表示无论参观哪里，横线处填哪一个？
explanation: Wherever 等于 no matter where。Where 只表示某个地方，没有“无论”。

prompt: 哪一句和 No matter what the scenery is 意思相同？

choices.text: Whatever the scenery is, we will stop
What the scenery is, we will stop
No matter whatever the scenery is
Whatever is the scenery we stop as a question

explanation: Whatever 可以替换 no matter what。
verify: "Whatever the scenery is, we will stop"

prompt: whoever 在让步句里相当于哪一个？
explanation: 让步用法的 whoever 等于 no matter who。

prompt: 哪一句的 where 引导地点状语从句？

choices.text: The tower where we waited is old
This is the temple where we prayed
The place where we met is quiet
Where there is a tower, there is a queue

explanation: 句首 Where there is a tower 没有先行词，是地点状语从句。其余 where 前面都有名词。
verify: "Where there is a tower, there is a queue"

prompt: Put the statue ___ it can be seen. 横线处填哪一个？
explanation: where 引导地点状语从句，说明放在能被看见的地方。

prompt: The landmark where we took photos 里，where 修饰哪一个词？
explanation: where 紧跟 landmark，是定语从句，不是状语从句。

prompt: 哪里有寺庙，哪里就有游客。哪一句正确？

choices.text: The temple where there are visitors is where
Where a temple there is visitors
Where there is a temple, there are visitors
There is a temple where there, visitors

explanation: Where there is a temple 是地点状语从句。
verify: "Where there is a temple, there are visitors"

prompt: 想说无论谁当导游都九点集合，哪一句合适？

choices.text: Whoever the guide is, we meet at nine
Whoever is the guide, we meet at nine as a question order
Who the guide is we meet

explanation: Whoever the guide is 是让步从句，用陈述语序。
verify: "Whoever the guide is, we meet at nine"

prompt: 想告诉游客把包放在能看见雕像的地方，哪一句合适？

choices.text: Leave your bag which you can see the statue
Leave your bag where you can see the statue
Leave your bag what you can see
Where leave your bag the statue

explanation: where you can see the statue 是地点状语从句。
verify: "Leave your bag where you can see the statue"

prompt: 想介绍这座塔是城市地标，哪一句合适？

choices.text: The tower are a landmark of the city
The tower is an landmark of the city
The tower is a landmark of the city
The tower is the landmarks of the city

explanation: is a landmark 用来介绍地标。
verify: "The tower is a landmark of the city"

prompt: 想说无论景色如何都会停留，哪一句合适？

choices.text: What the scenery is we stop
Whatever the scenery is, we will stop

explanation: Whatever the scenery is 表示无论景色怎样。
verify: "Whatever the scenery is, we will stop"

prompt: Where there is a tower, visitors queue for photos. Whoever the guide is, the group meets at the statue. The temple where they prayed is older than the tower. 游客在什么地方排队拍照？
explanation: Where there is a tower, visitors queue。

prompt: Where there is a tower, visitors queue for photos. Whoever the guide is, the group meets at the statue. The temple where they prayed is older than the tower. 集合地点是哪里？
explanation: the group meets at the statue。

prompt: Where there is a tower, visitors queue for photos. Whoever the guide is, the group meets at the statue. The temple where they prayed is older than the tower. the temple where they prayed 里的 where 修饰什么？
explanation: where 前面有 temple，是定语从句。

prompt: Where there is a tower, visitors queue for photos. Whoever the guide is, the group meets at the statue. The temple where they prayed is older than the tower. 导游换了人，集合时间会变吗？

choices.text: 不会，无论谁当导游都在雕像处集合

explanation: Whoever the guide is 表示无论导游是谁。
verify: "不会，无论谁当导游都在雕像处集合"

prompt: 要点：有塔就排队、无论谁当导游都在雕像处集合、他们祈祷过的寺庙更古老。哪一句三个要点都有？

choices.text: Where there is a tower people queue, whoever the guide is the group meets at the statue, and the temple where they prayed is older

explanation: 三个要点都要出现。
verify: "Where there is a tower people queue, whoever the guide is the group meets at the statue, and the temple where they prayed is older"

prompt: 说明里告诉游客把票放在能看见的地方，哪一句正确？

choices.text: Keep the ticket which you can see it
Keep the ticket what you can see
Keep the ticket where you can see it

explanation: where you can see it 是地点状语从句。
verify: "Keep the ticket where you can see it"

prompt: 哪一句适合作为说明的第一句？

choices.text: This walk starts at the city landmark
This walk start at the city landmark
This walk starting at the city landmark
This walk starts in the city landmark

explanation: 说明可以先写出起点。
verify: "This walk starts at the city landmark"

prompt: 表示无论景色如何都拍照，哪一句正确？

choices.text: What the scenery is, take a photo
Whatever the scenery is, take a photo
No matter whatever take a photo

explanation: Whatever the scenery is 表示无论景色怎样。
verify: "Whatever the scenery is, take a photo"
